title: Enterprise Content & Payment CMS Engine

title: Distributed Microservice API Gateway

title: Real-time Event Streaming Pipeline
description: Scalable event-driven system built with Kafka and Node.js to ingest, transform, and aggregate user activity metrics in real-time.
